caption: The drawing consists of three rectangular swatches of patterned fabric aligned vertically on a plain, off-white background. The top swatch has a brown base with a pattern of vertical wavy lines, where tan, dark blue, and beige elements create a repeating motif. The middle swatch features a dark brown background adorned with green leafy vines and clusters of light blue and beige flowers, with the botanicals scattered diagonally across the fabric. The bottom swatch has a background with a mix of dark brown and tan, overlaid with a pattern of leaves and rounded fruit or berry shapes in off-white, light green, and greenish-blue tones, repeated throughout. At the bottom right of the sheet is the handwritten name "Albert Levene."
title: Printed Cottons from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
